label: Revitalized Gonzalez’s Black feminist epistemology in Lugar de Fala
description: Ribeiro foregrounded Lélia Gonzalez’s critique of Brazilian racial democracy as the direct philosophical foundation for her concept of locus of enunciation (lugar de fala).
dialecticalTension: Brings 1980s Amefricanidade into 21st-century Brazilian public philosophy.

label: Built on Carneiro’s critique of epistemicide to democratize philosophical speech
description: Extending Carneiro’s concept of epistemicide, Ribeiro analyzed how marginalized Black women’s knowledge is systematically silenced as "particular" while white speech poses as "universal."
dialecticalTension: Operationalizes anti-epistemicide philosophy into contemporary Brazilian standpoint ethics.

label: Adapted Black feminist standpoint epistemology to Lusophone contexts
description: Ribeiro directly engaged Patricia Hill Collins’s Black Feminist Thought alongside Brazilian thinkers to clarify that standpoint is structural positionality, not mere personal opinion.
dialecticalTension: Synthesizes North American and Afro-Brazilian standpoint epistemologies.
